newsitem.title: FINLAND: Metsa-Botnia says to boost pulp output.
newsitem.headline: Metsa-Botnia says to boost pulp output.

text.p: Finnish pulp producer Oy Metsa-Botnia Ab said in a statement on Friday it would invest 900 million markka over three years to raise pulp output at its Joutseno mill by 100,000 tonnes to over 400,000 tonnes a year.
"The aim of the investment is to secure the competitiveness of the pulp mill far into the future," Metsa-Botnia said.
Of the investment cost, 200 million markka would be paid this year. The upgraded mill would be ready early in 1999.

The increase in production would not lead to an increase in available market pulp since the Joutseno mill's entire output would be used by Metsa-Botnia's owners Metsa-Serla Oy and UPM-Kymmene Oy, it said.
